conf.description: HSPD-12 CMS PIV credential-lifecycle audit direct route: dedup, FASC-N hashing, cert-serial normalization and privacy-conscious field drops in the collector pipeline per recommendations.direct.cribl - EVERY vendor field name is an unconfirmed placeholder (no documented CMS export schema exists for USAccess/MyID)

conf.comment: HSPD-12 CMS (USAccess/MyID) PIV lifecycle audit polled via REST/DB collector. HONESTY WARNING from the work order: no public field-level export schema exists for either exemplar - every field name below is a FIPS 201-3/SP 800-79-2 placeholder concept name, not a confirmed vendor column. Confirm against a real export before relying on this in production.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and placeholder-field honesty warning
Extract one polled lifecycle record (assumed JSON body) into top-level fields

Recommendations.direct.cribl: derive a dedup key from request id + event type + timestamp, since a polled collector will re-read overlapping windows; suppress keeps the whole first event per key for an hour and skips events missing a key field
drop the suppress=0 marker the suppress function stamps on every event it keeps
Recommendations.direct.cribl: hash the FASC-N before anything leaves the collector - it embeds agency/system/person codes and is PII

Computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename: event_type normalized onto a safe generic token (raw kept alongside since the deployment's real vocabulary is unconfirmed), event.outcome left undefined rather than defaulting to success, x509 serial normalized to uppercase/no-separator hex for the pki-ocsp cross-map join, and message length-capped since it is unbounded operator free text
Batch rename of the direct 1:1 fields; fascn is renamed after the mask step already hashed its value
Event time from the CMS's own record of the transition. Never targets @timestamp (platform constraint) - Elastic's destination maps _time back to @timestamp

event.dataset (no hyphen) and cleanup. adjudication_status is dropped ENTIRELY per recommendations.direct.cribl - the Privacy Act-sensitive determination value is never carried; the fact that an adjudication transition occurred is already visible via event.action
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
